deadline.value: The fall deadline is December 1, 2026; later applicants can still apply but risk losing most funded GRA/GTA positions.

also.quote: The School will accept applications past this deadline; however, students who apply later risk losing the majority of funded GRA/GTA opportunities within the School and the National Weather Center

gre_general.value: The School removed the GRE as an application requirement in August 2020.
gre_general.quote: As of August 2020, the School of Meteorology faculty voted to remove the GRE as a requirement for application to our graduate program

funding.value: Admission is selective, and the School typically offers 20 to 30 teaching and research assistantships a year.
funding.quote: The graduate program is selective | We typically offer between 20 to 30 Teaching and Research Assistantships in the program each year

entry_route.value: Direct entry to the PhD is allowed, but the School strongly advises starting with an MS.
entry_route.quote: the School of Meteorology strongly advises you to first enroll as an MS degree student

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a subject GRE for this field.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor is needed before admission.

notes: Covers the Atmospheric Science PhD. The Environmental Science PhD in CEES is not covered.
